item.title: Foresight AI Brings Gremlin Agents to Reliability Engineering
item.description: Reliability management company Gremlin has announced the general availability of Foresight AI, an agentic product that analyses services for potential failures, recommends changes and reruns tests to check that a fix works. By Matt Saunders (1 source: infoq)
